summary: P1 Watchtower (IA Presidente + Relacionamento) shell — backend + frontend validated end-to-end. All 11 backend tests pass (5 helper-level via test_watchtower_ia.py + 6 HTTP-level via new test_watchtower_shell_http.py) and full UI navigation works: 5 sub-tabs render, default is IA Presidente, Relacionamento handles empty data gracefully, Patrimônio shows locked placeholder, window picker (1h/6h/24h/7d/30d) + Atualizar button work, localStorage 'watchtower_active_tab' persists across reload.
critical_code_review_comments: WatchtowerRelacionamento empty-state UX is excellent (handles total=0, top_clients=[], vips=[], samples=[] without crashing).
_top_clients_by_memories uses avg_confidence as trust_score proxy — consider documenting that this is approximation (not real trust score from isabella_confidence service).
IA Presidente shows ISABELLA INDEX 36.1 (CRÍTICO red badge) — expected in demo env per E1 note; component reads/renders correctly.

wa_dispatch metrics endpoint exposes failure samples with raw evolution provider error strings (e.g. '500 Internal Server Error for url ...') — may leak internal URLs in UI; consider sanitization if shown to non-admin roles.
seed_data_creation: None — co-demo dataset already exercised the endpoints (17 wa_dispatch_metrics with 9 failures as expected).
